records.title: Semi-Clairvoyant Scheduling of Speculative Decoding Requests to Minimize LLM Inference Latency
records.reason: LAPS-SDは生成長と受理率の変化に応じてspeculative decoding要求の優先度・プリエンプションを切替え、serving平均レイテンシを下げる。

records.title: Dependency-Aware Semi-Structured Sparsity of GLU Variants in Large Language Models
records.reason: DaSSはGLU系LLMの重みと中間活性を併せて枝刈り重要度を求め、依存関係を保ったhardware-friendly N:M sparsityへ落とし込む。

records.title: EconoServe: Maximizing Multi-Resource Utilization with SLO Guarantees in LLM Serving
records.reason: EconoServeはprompt/generation別queue、応答長別batching、KVC先行確保と未使用領域のpipeline共有でGPU/KV cache双方の利用率とSLOを改善するserving scheduler。

records.title: Autoregressive Language Modeling using Compressed Sequence Mixing
records.reason: CAT attends to compressed sequence chunks to reduce per-token inference work and memory; the abstract reports up to 3x generation throughput and 7x lower memory than dense transformers.

records.title: Deconstructing Attention: Investigating Design Principles for Effective Language Modeling
records.reason: 本研究はdot-product attentionの設計要素を層ごとに緩和し、通常attentionとの混在で性能を保てる条件を分析する。要旨は簡素化の可能性を示すが、実行時間・メモリ削減は測定していないため、効率への接点は限定的。

records.title: Unifying Linear-Time Attention via Latent Probabilistic Modelling
records.reason: 潜在確率モデルに方向性を持つ線形attentionと再帰的query/keyを導入し、長系列の二次attention計算を避けながら言語モデル品質を保つ。

records.title: VcLLM: Video Codecs are Secretly Tensor Codecs
records.reason: GPUの動画codecをLLM tensor codecとして使い、training/inference時のテンソル保存・転送量を圧縮してメモリ容量と帯域の制約を緩和する。

records.title: Lag-Relative Sparse Attention In Long Context Training
records.reason: LRSA/LagKVは遅延窓から重要KVを選んでchunkごとにprefillし、長文脈LLMでKV圧縮後の計算・メモリ負荷と性能劣化を抑える。

records.title: Semantic Scheduling for LLM Inference
records.reason: Semantic SchedulingはLLM promptの内容から優先度を決める計算量最適なrequest schedulerで、LLM servingの待ち時間を直接短縮する。

records.title: HA-RAG: Hotness-Aware RAG Acceleration via Mixed Precision and Data Placement
records.reason: HA-RAGはKV chunkのhotnessに応じた混合精度圧縮と高速memory配置でdisk I/Oを抑え、RAGのTTFTを改善する。

records.title: Scaling Laws For Mixed Quantization
records.reason: 論文はLLM規模に応じた混合量子化率とblock sizeの損失則を与え、推論時の低bit化と不要なhardware細分化の回避に使える。

records.title: Alchemist: Towards the Design of Efficient Online Continual Learning System
records.reason: Alchemistはprefill時のserving activation/KV cacheをonline trainingへ再利用し、重複計算を減らしながら学習throughputとメモリ効率を上げ、serving latencyも保つ。

records.title: Optimal Formats for Weight Quantisation
records.reason: 量子化formatの最適設計とtensorごとのbit幅配分を導き、要旨ではLLMに適用してパラメータ当たり最大0.25 bitを削減する。

records.title: NoWag: A Unified Framework for Shape Preserving Compression of Large Language Models
records.reason: NoWagはLlama-2/3へweight/activation情報を使うshape-preserving事後圧縮を適用し、vector quantizationとpruningでLLMの計算・メモリ需要を抑える。

records.title: I-LLM: Efficient Integer-Only Inference for Fully-Quantized Low-Bit Large Language Models
records.reason: The primary abstract proposes fully integer-only post-training quantization for LLM inference, including integer matrix multiplication and nonlinear operators for edge/cloud deployment.

records.title: HAP-E: Hessian-Aware Structured Pruning of LLMs for Efficient Inference
records.reason: The paper proposes hardware-latency-targeted structured pruning for LLMs using adaptive Hessian-guided budget allocation and a latency predictor.

records.title: Automatic Task Detection and Heterogeneous LLM Speculative Decoding
records.reason: task分類器でpromptを振り分け、タスク別heterogeneous draft modelを使い分けるspeculative decodingにより、下流タスクでの受理率と推論速度を改善する。

records.title: EcoxPU: Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration for Energy-Efficient Disaggregated LLM Inference on Heterogeneous xPUs
records.reason: IEEE abstract describes runtime coordination of PD and FFN disaggregation across heterogeneous accelerators to reduce LLM inference energy while controlling latency.

records.title: Composite Attention: A Framework for Combining Sequence Mixing Primitives
records.reason: The workshop paper formalizes hybrid sequence-mixer compositions as a way to reduce transformer compute while retaining quality; its contribution is directly tied to efficient sequence modeling.

records.title: Out-of-Vocabulary Sampling Boosts Speculative Decoding
records.reason: RDKはtoken-affinity priorsで小語彙drafterの確率質量を再配分し、語彙を大幅に刈り込んでもspeculative decodingの受理率を保つ線形時間sampler。
